programme.title: All Is True
programme.desc: The year is 1613, and Shakespeare is acknowledged as the greatest writer of the age. But disaster strikes when his renowned Globe Theatre burns to the ground. Devastated, Shakespeare returns to Stratford, where he must face a troubled past and a neglected family. Haunted by the death of his only son, Hamnet, he struggles to mend the broken relationship with his wife and daughters. In so doing, he is ruthlessly forced to examine his own failings as a husband and father.

programme.title: "Wuthering Heights"
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.

She cannot understand how different he has become. Can the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-Birds really be the same person? Perhaps her new friends, the Pink Ladies, can help her win back his heart?

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: In the 1900s Vienna, mesmeric entertainer Eisenheim's magical abilities are wowing the crowds, with an act that ranges from mere tricks to an apparent capacity to raise the dead. However, he has also long been in love with Duchess Sophie von Teschen, which puts him in dangerous competition with the violent, scheming Crown Prince Leopold, who jumps at the opportunity to have the magician arrested on grounds of necromancy.

programme.title: Pillion

With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

programme.title: Liar Liar

programme.title: Caddyshack

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Wombat
programme.desc: For wombats, the mating season is a departure from the solitary lives they tend to favour. While often slow and lumbering, they can be surprisingly energetic when it is time for courtship, including taking part in a ritualised chase.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: A younger and stronger leopard challenges Kamuti for her territory in the Luangwa Valley, where she has reigned for ten years.

programme.title: Violent Earth
programme.desc: Wildfires are becoming megafires, devastating populated areas and causing tragic loss of life, as seen with the Yarnell Hill Fire and the Maui Fire in Lahaina, Hawaii; experts investigate the science and causes behind this phenomenon.

programme.title: Monkey Life
programme.desc: There is a scuffle between the female capuchins, Tia needs surgery, and orangutan Amy is heavily pregnant - and very grumpy. Meanwhile, there is something new in the play area of the chimp nursery, and Alison has her last visit with Paulo.

programme.title: Monkey Life
programme.desc: Chimp Ben has a nasty infection and animal director Jeremy is worried it may lead to him losing his foot. Elsewhere, golden-cheeked gibbon Tien has undergone a transformation, and keeper Holly checks up on Xuzy.

programme.title: Shark with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Steve explores the radical variety of sharks that call the Atlantic Ocean their home and marks the start of a global journey in the so-called shark capital of the world, the Bahamas.

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough follows baby animals as they communicate in their quest for survival, using sound to beg and call for help in the vulnerable early days of life in the natural world.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fuelled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview
programme.desc: Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

programme.title: Snatch

programme.title: Madeleine McCann: Searching for the Prime Suspect
programme.desc: 18 years after Madeleine McCann's disappearance from a holiday apartment in Portugal, the mystery remains unsolved and the investigation is still active - German prosecutors recently made headlines by confirming that Christian Brueckner, the man they've long believed responsible, is set to be released from prison with no charges imminent in relation to Madeleine's abduction and suspected murder. Why are German authorities so certain of his guilt and yet still unable to prove it? Criminologist Dr Graham Hill, a former senior Met detective who was in Portugal during the early stages of the investigation into Madeleine McCann's disappearance and assisted local police, returns to Praia da Luz for the first time in this powerful documentary - by revisiting the scene of her disappearance and unpicking a criminal history, Dr Hill examines the case against the man who remains the prime suspect and who has consistently denied any involvement in Madeleine McCann's disappearance.
